name: Paywall Crawler
hook: Guide the rogue AI crawler through premium newswalls and captchas
tagline: A cheeky neural spider slithers past subscription prompts, spinning credit cards and dodging digital bouncers as the multiplier ascends. Cashing out whisks the scraper into an incognito tab with full PDF dumps. Crashing slams a 403 Forbidden banhammer down, obliterating the crawler into spinning captchas.
